name: cavemio-waitlist-field
title: Waitlist field
description: An email field that becomes its own answer: the button stretches across it, then settles as "You’re on the list · #1,248".

cavemio.accessibility:
- A real form: Enter submits, the field has a label, autocomplete="email" and the right mobile keyboard.
- The hint is linked to the field with aria-describedby, and joining or failing is announced from a status region.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph alongside it.
- With reduced motion there is no shake or sweep; states change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: – · Runs on a valid email. Resolve to show the joined state, throw to show Try again.

props.name: joined
props.description: – · Show the joined state straight away, e.g. for someone already on the list.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ idle; pending; success; error; invalid }>
props.description: – · Wording for each state and the invalid hint.

features.title: One surface
features.description: The email and the button sit in one thin line pill, and the button’s width is measured so the stretch starts from it.

features.title: Validation with a hint
features.description: A bad address shakes the pill, tints its edge red and shows “Enter a full email address” under it.

features.title: It shows it is working
features.description: The button stretches across the field with a light sweeping through it while it joins.

features.title: The answer in place
features.description: A check draws, the label becomes “You’re on the list” and the place in line rolls up to #1,248.

features.title: Failures fold back
features.description: If the request fails, the button returns to its own width with a shake and “Try again”.

features.title: A real form
features.description: Enter submits, the field has a label and autocomplete="email", and joining or failing is announced.

states.title: idle
states.description: Email and "Join the waitlist" in one thin line pill; the button’s width is measured so the stretch starts exactly from it.

states.title: invalid
states.description: A 380ms shake, the pill’s edge tints red and "Enter a full email address" slides in below. Typing clears it.

states.title: joining
states.description: The button stretches across the field (560ms) and a light band sweeps through it; the label morphs to "Joining".

states.title: joined
states.description: A check draws itself, the label morphs to "You’re on the list" and the place rolls up to #1,248.

states.title: failed
states.description: The button folds back to its own width with a shake and "Try again".
